pli-tv-bi-vb-pc27:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhunisaṅghassa akālacīvaraṃ uppannaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc27:1.3: atha kho bhikkhunisaṅgho taṃ cīvaraṃ bhājetukāmo sannipati.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc27:1.4: tena kho pana samayena thullanandāya bhikkhuniyā antevāsī bhikkhuniyo pakkantā honti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc27:1.6: “ayye bhikkhuniyo pakkantā na tāva cīvaraṃ bhājīyissatī”ti dhammikaṃ
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc27:1.8: bhikkhuniyo na tāva cīvaraṃ bhājīyissatīti pakkamiṃsu
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc27:1.9: thullanandā bhikkhunī antevāsibhikkhunīsu āgatāsu taṃ cīvaraṃ bhājāpesi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc27:1.10: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc27:1.11: “kathaṃ hi nāma ayyā thullanandā dhammikaṃ cīvaravibhaṅgaṃ paṭibāhissatī”ti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc27:1.12: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave, thullanandā bhikkhunī dhammikaṃ cīvaravibhaṅgaṃ paṭibāhīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc27:1.15: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhave thullanandā bhikkhunī dhammikaṃ cīvaravibhaṅgaṃ paṭibāhissati.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc27:1.17: evañca pana bhikkhave, bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc27:1.18.1: “yā pana bhikkhunī dhammikaṃ cīvaravibhaṅgaṃ paṭibāheyya, pācittiya”nti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc27:2.1.8: kathaṃ idaṃ cīvaraṃ bhājeyyāti paṭibāhati āpatti pācittiyassa.
